plugin.name: MarketWatch
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Watch the market and auction channel for wanted items; one-click bids.

trigger.match: ^Current bid on (.+) is now ([\d,]+)\. Min bid is ([\d,]+)\.?
^(?:Auction:\s*)?(\S+) has placed a bid for ([\d,]+) gold on (.+) \(Level \d+, Num (\d+)\)

muclient.script:
require "serialize"
-- Aardwolf's shipped silent command-capture module (MUSHclient/lua/ -- wrapped_captures.lua). Brackets a command with echo tags and gags the whole -- response, so we can read "market list" without it hitting the screen. local gHaveCapture = pcall (require, "wrapped_captures")
-- gmcphelper gives us gmcp("room.info.num"), which asks the GMCP handler -- plugin for its CURRENT cached value. That matters: room.info is only -- broadcast when you change rooms, so a plugin that only listens would not -- know where you are until you next moved. local gHaveGmcp = pcall (require, "gmcphelper")
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours / echo helpers (standard theme) -- ===================================================================== -- Only these four colours are used anywhere in this plugin. local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets, and muted secondary detail local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 plugin name, and anything needing notice local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 values, commands, clickable actions
-- Roles mapped onto the four, so the rest of the code can stay readable. local CLR_WARN = CLR_NAME -- refusals / attention local CLR_DIM = CLR_TAG -- secondary detail lines
local TAG = "MarketWatch"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function warn (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_WARN, "", msg) end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-26s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
local function dbg (msg) if gCfg and gCfg.debug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw] " .. msg) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Small utilities -- ===================================================================== local function trim (s) return (tostring (s or ""):match ("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) end
-- Amounts go into commands, so they must always render as plain digits - -- never "1.2e+15", never a trailing ".0". local function intstr (n) return string.format ("%d", math.floor (tonumber (n) or 0)) end
local function commafy (n) local s = tostring (math.floor (tonumber (n) or 0)) local k repeat s, k = s:gsub ("^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") until k == 0 return s end
-- "1200000000", "1,200,000,000", "1.2b", "500m", "25k" -> number local function parseAmount (s) s = trim (s):gsub (",", ""):lower () local n, suf = s:match ("^(%d+%.?%d*)([kmb]?)$") if not n then return nil end n = tonumber (n) if not n then return nil end if suf == "k" then n = n * 1000 elseif suf == "m" then n = n * 1000000 elseif suf == "b" then n = n * 1000000000 end if n < 1 then return nil end return math.floor (n) end
-- Reduce a name to a comparable form: lowercase, and every character that is -- not a letter or digit becomes a space. This makes decorated / restrung -- names like "|10[Ten of Earth]10|" compare as "10 ten of earth 10", so the -- user never has to type the decoration. local function norm (s) s = tostring (s or ""):lower () s = s:gsub ("[^a-z0-9]", " ") s = s:gsub ("%s+", " ") return trim (s) end
-- Split a watch pattern on "*" into normalised literal pieces. Matching then -- means "these pieces appear, in this order" - which is exactly glob -- semantics, without ever building a Lua pattern out of user text. local function splitGlob (raw) local parts, out = {}, {} local start = 1 while true do local s = raw:find ("*", start, true) if not s then parts [#parts + 1] = raw:sub (start) break end parts [#parts + 1] = raw:sub (start, s - 1) start = s + 1 end for _, p in ipairs (parts) do local n = norm (p) if n ~= "" then out [#out + 1] = n end end return out end
-- Do all pieces appear in order inside hay? (plain find, no pattern magic) local function piecesMatch (hay, pieces) if not pieces or #pieces == 0 then return false end local pos = 1 for _, p in ipairs (pieces) do local s, e = hay:find (p, pos, true) if not s then return false end pos = e + 1 end return true end
-- Does a prefix of p (>= 4 chars) sit at the very end of vis? That means the -- match may simply have been cut off by the 28-char column. local function straddles (vis, p) local maxk = math.min (#vis, #p) for k = maxk, 4, -1 do if vis:sub (-k) == p:sub (1, k) then return true end end return false end
-- Could this pattern still match once the truncated tail is known? local function couldMatchTruncated (vis, pieces) if not pieces or #pieces == 0 then return false end local pos = 1 for i, p in ipairs (pieces) do local s, e = vis:find (p, pos, true) if not s then -- earlier pieces matched, so the rest may live in the cut-off tail if i > 1 then return true end return straddles (vis, p) end pos = e + 1 end return true end
-- flatten one captured style-run list into plain text local function styleText (styles) if type (styles) ~= "table" then return "" end local parts = {} for _, run in ipairs (styles) do parts [#parts + 1] = run.text or "" end return table.concat (parts) end
local function textsOf (lines) local t = {} for _, s in ipairs (lines or {}) do t [#t + 1] = styleText (s) end return t end
-- ===================================================================== -- Persistent data (own file - SetVariable is lost on manual reinstall) -- ===================================================================== -- ===================================================================== -- The commands sent to the MUD. Fixed, not configurable. -- marketplace ("long auction"): one command does both jobs -- lbid <num> read an item's stats box -- lbid <num> <amt> proxy confirm place a proxy bid -- lbid <num> <buyout> buy it outright ("proxy" is -- meaningless - there is nothing to -- bid up to - so the short form) -- live auction channel: a different system entirely -- bid <num> <amt> -- ===================================================================== local CMD_BID = "lbid $num $amt proxy confirm" local CMD_BUY = "lbid $num $amt" local CMD_PROBE = "lbid $num" local CMD_AUC = "bid $num $amt" local CMD_AUCID = "bid $num" -- shows the auction item, no amount = no bid
local DATA_FILE = "MarketWatch_data.lua"
gCfg = { -- $num and $amt are substituted before sending auc = true, -- watch the auction channel at all mkt = true, -- watch the market channel too aucdebug = false, popup = true, -- pop a window up for act-now opportunities withdraw = false, -- pull gold from the bank when a bid falls short withdrawroom = 0, -- only ever do that in this room (0 = unset) deep = false, -- probe EVERY truncated row, not just likely ones probe_delay = 0.6, -- seconds between silent stats probes probe_max = 30, -- hard cap on probes per scan debug = false, }
local gWatch = {} -- { {raw=, pieces=, max=, added=}, ... }
local function dataPath () return GetInfo (66) .. DATA_FILE end
-- Items we have already put a bid (or buyout) on. num -> os.time(). -- Persisted: a proxy bid stands until the auction ends, so re-offering the -- link would only ever waste gold. Pruned when the item leaves the market. gBid = {}
-- Same idea for the LIVE auction channel. Kept separate because auction item -- numbers are a completely different, small, recycled namespace ("Num 97") and -- would otherwise collide with market numbers ("64817"). gAucBid = {}
-- What we bid on each live auction. num -> amount. Persisted with gAucBid, so a -- reload cannot make us forget it - the next tier is measured against this. gAucAmt = {}
-- What we bid on each MARKET item. num -> amount. Persisted with gBid. It is -- how an outbid is told from "we are the high bidder": a current bid above this -- means someone has passed us. gMktAmt = {}
-- Buyout prices learned from the market channel ("This item has a buyout price -- of N"). That announcement is the one place a buyout is stated in a form we -- have actually seen, so it is remembered and reused by 'marketw' scans later. gKnownBuyout = {}
local AUC_BID_TTL = 3600 -- forget an auction bid after an hour local AUC_TTL = 300 -- an auction line's link goes stale after 5 minutes
-- Bid tiers: every watch entry has max (tier 1) and optionally max2 and max3 -- (each higher than the one before). On a LIVE auction the lowest tier that -- beats the current price is the one offered; when someone outbids you, the next -- tier up is offered in the pop-up. Nothing is sent until you click. local gAucOffer = {} -- auction num -> { amt = last tier offered, when = os.time () }
local function tierList (w) local t = { w.max } if w.max2 then t [#t + 1] = w.max2 end if w.max3 then t [#t + 1] = w.max3 end return t end
-- Lowest tier strictly above cur (tier 1 when there is no current bid). -- Returns amount, tier number - or nil when every tier is already beaten. local function nextTier (w, cur) for i, amt in ipairs (tierList (w)) do if not cur or amt > cur then return amt, i end end return nil end
local function tierText (w) local parts = {} for _, amt in ipairs (tierList (w)) do parts [#parts + 1] = commafy (amt) end return table.concat (parts, " / ") end
-- Per-item watch mode. Stored as "both" (default), "auc" or "mark". -- both = marketplace scan + market channel + auction channel -- auc = live auction channel only -- mark = marketplace scan + market channel only local MODE_LABEL = { both = "both", auc = "auction only", mark = "market only" }
local function parseMode (s) s = trim (s):lower () if s == "both" or s == "all" then return "both" end if s == "auc" or s == "auction" then return "auc" end if s == "mark" or s == "market" or s == "mkt" then return "mark" end return nil end
-- Which channel is asking? "auc" = live auction, "mkt" = marketplace (scan -- or market channel). Does this entry's mode allow it? local function modeAllows (w, chan) local m = w.mode or "both" if m == "both" then return true end if chan == "auc" then return m == "auc" end return m == "mark" end
local function saveData () local plain = {} for i, w in ipairs (gWatch) do plain [i] = { raw = w.raw, max = w.max, max2 = w.max2, max3 = w.max3, added = w.added, mode = w.mode or "both" } end -- serialize wants string keys for a sparse map local bid = {} for num, t in pairs (gBid) do bid [tostring (num)] = t end local abid = {} for num, t in pairs (gAucBid) do abid [tostring (num)] = t end local aamt = {} for num, v in pairs (gAucAmt) do aamt [tostring (num)] = v end local mamt = {} for num, v in pairs (gMktAmt) do mamt [tostring (num)] = v end local buy = {} for num, p in pairs (gKnownBuyout) do buy [tostring (num)] = p end local body = "return " .. serialize.save_simple ( { watch = plain, cfg = gCfg, bid = bid, aucbid = abid, aucamt = aamt, mktamt = mamt, buyout = buy }) local tmp = dataPath () .. ".tmp" local f, err = io.open (tmp, "w") if not f then warn ("cannot save watch list: " .. tostring (err)) return false end f:write (body) f:close () os.remove (dataPath ()) os.rename (tmp, dataPath ()) return true end
local function loadData () local f = io.open (dataPath (), "r") if not f then return end local body = f:read ("*a") f:close () local chunk = loadstring (body) if not chunk then warn ("watch list file is corrupt - starting empty") return end local ok, t = pcall (chunk) if not ok or type (t) ~= "table" then return end if type (t.cfg) == "table" then -- Only keys that still exist are restored, so settings retired in later -- versions (the old bidcmd / buycmd / cap) are ignored, not resurrected. for k, v in pairs (t.cfg) do if gCfg [k] ~= nil then gCfg [k] = v end end end gWatch = {} for _, w in ipairs (t.watch or {}) do if w.raw and w.max then gWatch [#gWatch + 1] = { raw = w.raw, max = w.max, added = w.added or 0, max2 = tonumber (w.max2), max3 = tonumber (w.max3), mode = parseMode (w.mode or "") or "both", pieces = splitGlob (w.raw), } end end gBid = {} for num, when in pairs (t.bid or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n then gBid [n] = when end end gMktAmt = {} for num, v in pairs (t.mktamt or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n and gBid [n] and tonumber (v) then gMktAmt [n] = tonumber (v) end end gAucBid = {} local now = os.time () for num, when in pairs (t.aucbid or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n and now - when < AUC_BID_TTL then gAucBid [n] = when end end gAucAmt = {} for num, v in pairs (t.aucamt or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n and gAucBid [n] and tonumber (v) then gAucAmt [n] = tonumber (v) end end gKnownBuyout = {} for num, price in pairs (t.buyout or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n then gKnownBuyout [n] = price end end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Scan state -- ===================================================================== local gScanning = false local gScanStart = 0
-- Live state from GMCP local gRoom = nil -- room.info "num" local gGold = nil -- char.worth "gold" (on hand) local gBank = nil -- char.worth "bank"
-- The last bid we actually sent, so that a "not enough gold" reply can be -- tied back to it. { num, amt, auction, when } local gLastBid = nil local BID_FAIL_WINDOW = 20 -- seconds a failure may still refer to that bid
-- Where are we? Ask the GMCP handler for its cached room.info first - it -- always knows, even if we have not moved since loading. The value fed to us -- by room.info broadcasts is only a fallback. local function currentRoom () if gHaveGmcp then -- gmcphelper's gmcp() stores its result in a global called "data" and -- returns that global. If the lookup fails it leaves the PREVIOUS value -- in place, so clear it first - otherwise a failed read hands back the -- last room we successfully saw. data = nil local ok, v = pcall (gmcp, "room.info.num") if ok then local n = tonumber (v) if n then return n end end end return gRoom end local gRows = {} -- num -> row table for the CURRENT scan only local gOrder = {} -- nums, in market-list order, that we will report local gQueue = {} -- nums still to probe local gProbeCount = 0 local gHidBid = 0 -- matches skipped this scan: we already bid local gHidPrice = 0 -- matches skipped this scan: bidding is already over our max
local SCAN_TTL = 600 -- a scan's results go stale after 10 minutes
-- ===================================================================== -- Parsing 'market list' -- ===================================================================== -- Fixed-width layout, verified against real output: -- 1..6 num | 7 sp | 8..35 item (28) | 36 sp | 37..39 lvl | 40 sp -- 41..45 type | 46 sp | 47..62 last bid | 63 sp | 64..67 bids | 68 sp | 69.. time local function parseListRow (line) if #line < 68 then return nil end local num = tonumber (trim (line:sub (1, 6))) if not num then return nil end if line:sub (7, 7) ~= " " or line:sub (36, 36) ~= " " then return nil end
local rawname = line:sub (8, 35) local lvl = tonumber (trim (line:sub (37, 39))) local typefld = line:sub (41, 45) local bidtxt = trim (line:sub (47, 62)) local bids = tonumber (trim (line:sub (64, 67))) local timeft = trim (line:sub (69))
local star = typefld:find ("*", 1, true) ~= nil local ctype = trim (typefld:gsub ("%*", "")) local vis = trim (rawname)
-- The description column is 28 wide. Obviously cut off if char 28 is not a -- space. But a name cut exactly ON a space shows only 27 characters and -- looks complete, so anything 27 or longer has to be treated as suspect. local maybeCut = #vis >= 27
return { num = num, visible = vis, truncated = maybeCut, level = lvl, ctype = ctype, -- "Gold" / "QP" / ... star = star, -- meaning of '*' is not yet confirmed bid = tonumber ((bidtxt:gsub (",", ""))), bidtxt = bidtxt, bids = bids or 0, timeleft = timeft, } end
-- ===================================================================== -- Parsing the item box from 'lbid <num>' -- -- Verified against real output (2026-08-21). The whole reply is a box of -- "| Label : value |" lines: -- -- | Keywords : daily blessing qreset reset token | -- | Name : Daily Blessing Qreset Token | -- | Type : Treasure Level : 1 | -- ... -- | Market Item Number : 64911 | -- | Item is being sold by : Granuaile | -- | Auction will end in : 3 days and 16:40:04 | -- | Current bid : 25,000,000 gold (Ultimate) | -- -- Still unknown: the label used for a buyout price (this item has none), so -- any label containing "buyout" is accepted. Unreadable fields stay nil, and -- a nil name means no bid link is offered for a truncated row. -- ===================================================================== local function boxValue (line) -- "| Label : value |" -> "label", "value" local inner = line:match ("^%s*|(.*)|%s*$") if not inner then return nil end local label, value = inner:match ("^%s*([%a][%a%s]-)%s*:%s*(.*)$") if not label then return nil end return (label:lower ():gsub ("%s+", " ")), trim (value) end
local function firstNumber (s) local n = s and s:match ("([%d,]+)") return n and tonumber ((n:gsub (",", ""))) or nil end
-- The command that prints the box above. 'lbid <num>' is the verified form; -- the market list footer suggests 'market bid <num>' does the same. local function probeCmd (num) return (CMD_PROBE:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num))) end
local function parseStats (num, lines) local st = { num = num }
for _, t in ipairs (lines) do local label, value = boxValue (t) if label and value ~= "" then if label == "name" then -- first one wins: the stats box comes before the description text if not st.name then st.name = value end elseif label == "keywords" then if not st.keywords then st.keywords = value end elseif label == "market item number" then st.listnum = firstNumber (value) elseif label == "item is being sold by" then st.seller = value:match ("^(%S+)") elseif label == "auction will end in" then st.endsin = value elseif label == "current bid" then -- "25,000,000 gold (Ultimate)" st.bid = firstNumber (value) st.currency = value:match ("^[%d,]+%s+(%a+)") -- The name in brackets is the high bidder as far as I can tell, but -- that is an inference from one sample - it is only ever used to skip -- bidding against yourself, so a wrong guess costs nothing. st.bidder = value:match ("%(([^)]+)%)") elseif label:find ("buyout", 1, true) then st.buyout = firstNumber (value) elseif label:find ("minimum", 1, true) and label:find ("bid", 1, true) then st.minbid = firstNumber (value) end end end
-- The box states its own item number. If it disagrees with the one we asked -- about, the reply is not for our item - throw the whole thing away rather -- than bid on the strength of it. if st.listnum and st.listnum ~= num then return { num = num, mismatch = st.listnum } end
return st end
-- ===================================================================== -- Matching a row against the watch list -- ===================================================================== -- Returns: "sure" | "maybe" | nil, entry -- "sure" = the pattern matched text we can actually see, so it will also -- match the full name (a match inside a prefix implies a match in -- the whole string). -- "maybe" = the row is truncated and the pattern could still match the part -- we cannot see. Needs an 'lbid <num>' probe to decide. local function classifyRow (row) local best, bestKind = nil, nil local vis = norm (row.visible) for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do local kind = nil if not modeAllows (w, "mkt") then kind = nil -- auction-only entry: never matched on the market elseif piecesMatch (vis, w.pieces) then kind = "sure" elseif row.truncated and couldMatchTruncated (vis, w.pieces) then kind = "maybe" elseif row.truncated and gCfg.deep then kind = "maybe" end if kind then -- prefer a sure match, then the higher maximum if not best or (kind == "sure" and bestKind == "maybe") or (kind == bestKind and w.max > best.max) then best, bestKind = w, kind end end end return bestKind, best end
-- ===================================================================== -- Rendering -- ===================================================================== local function renderRow (row) local w = row.entry local st = row.stats -- A buyout heard on the market channel is authoritative; fall back to it -- when the stats box did not yield one. if st and not st.buyout then st.buyout = gKnownBuyout [row.num] end local name = (st and st.name) or (row.visible .. (row.truncated and "..." or ""))
-- header line: number, name, level, currency ColourNote ( CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-6d ", row.num), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-44s ", name:sub (1, 44)), CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("L%-4s %s", tostring (row.level or "?"), row.ctype or "?"))
-- detail line: bid / bidder / time / buyout local detail = string.format (" bid %s (%d bid%s)", commafy (row.bid or 0), row.bids, row.bids == 1 and "" or "s") if st and st.bidder then detail = detail .. " high: " .. st.bidder end detail = detail .. " ends " .. (row.timeleft or "?") if st and st.buyout then detail = detail .. " buyout " .. commafy (st.buyout) end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", detail) if st and st.seller then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " sold by " .. st.seller) end
-- action line ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format (" watch %q your max %s", w.raw, commafy (w.max)))
-- Items already bid on never reach here - they are filtered out of the scan -- entirely, because a standing proxy bid needs no further attention. local reasons = {} if row.ctype ~= "Gold" then reasons [#reasons + 1] = "not a gold auction" end -- Rows priced past our max are filtered out before this point, both from -- the list and again after the stats probe. if row.kind == "maybe" and not (st and st.name) then reasons [#reasons + 1] = "name is cut off and could not be confirmed" end
local canBuy = st and st.buyout and w.max >= st.buyout and row.ctype == "Gold" and not (row.kind == "maybe" and not st.name)
if #reasons > 0 then ColourNote (CLR_WARN, "", " no bid link: " .. table.concat (reasons, "; ")) end
-- The action line always carries [ ID ], even when there is nothing to bid -- with - being able to look the item over is useful either way. ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") local wrote = false if #reasons == 0 then local bidPreview = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (row.num)) :gsub ("%$amt", intstr (w.max)) Hyperlink ("mwbid " .. row.num, "[ BID up to " .. commafy (w.max) .. " ]", "Re-check this item, then send: " .. bidPreview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) wrote = true end if canBuy then if wrote then ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") end Hyperlink ("mwbuy " .. row.num, "[ BUY OUT " .. commafy (st.buyout) .. " ]", "Buy this item outright for " .. commafy (st.buyout), CLR_NAME, "black", 0, 1) wrote = true end if wrote then ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") end Hyperlink ("mwid " .. row.num, "[ ID ]", "Show the full item: " .. CMD_PROBE:gsub ("%$num", intstr (row.num)), CLR_TAG, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") end
local function renderResults () gScanning = false local n = #gOrder
-- say what was left out, so "hidden" never means "silently lost" local skipped = {} if gHidBid > 0 then skipped [#skipped + 1] = gHidBid .. " already bid" end if gHidPrice > 0 then skipped [#skipped + 1] = gHidPrice .. " over your max" end local hidden = #skipped > 0 and (" (" .. table.concat (skipped, ", ") .. ", hidden)") or ""
if n == 0 then if #skipped > 0 then echoHi ("nothing to act on - ", table.concat (skipped, " and "), " among your watched items.") else local nm = 0 for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do if modeAllows (w, "mkt") then nm = nm + 1 end end echoHi ("nothing on the market matches your ", tostring (nm), " market-watched item(s).") end return end echoHi ("", tostring (n), " match" .. (n == 1 and "" or "es") .. " on the market" .. hidden) Note ("") for _, num in ipairs (gOrder) do local row = gRows [num] if row and row.entry then renderRow (row) end end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " Links re-verify the item with a fresh 'lbid' read before anything is sent.") end
-- ===================================================================== -- Probe queue: resolve full names / buyout / high bidder -- ===================================================================== function MW_ProbeDone (num, lines) local row = gRows [num] if row then row.stats = parseStats (num, textsOf (lines)) dbg ("probe " .. num .. " name=" .. tostring (row.stats.name) .. " buyout=" .. tostring (row.stats.buyout) .. " bidder=" .. tostring (row.stats.bidder)) -- a "maybe" row is only kept if the full name really does match if row.kind == "maybe" then local full = row.stats.name if full and piecesMatch (norm (full), row.entry.pieces) then row.kind = "sure" elseif full then row.entry = nil -- confirmed NOT a match - drop it dbg ("probe " .. num .. " ruled out") end -- full == nil: parser could not read the name; renderRow refuses a link end -- The stats box is fresher than the list, so the bid may have moved past -- our max in between. Drop it rather than show something unactionable. if row.entry and row.stats.bid and row.stats.bid >= row.entry.max then row.entry = nil gHidPrice = gHidPrice + 1 dbg ("probe " .. num .. " dropped - bidding is past our max") end end DoAfterSpecial (gCfg.probe_delay, "MW_NextProbe ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_ProbeTimeout (num) dbg ("probe " .. tostring (num) .. " timed out") DoAfterSpecial (gCfg.probe_delay, "MW_NextProbe ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_NextProbe () if #gQueue == 0 then -- drop rows that the probe ruled out local keep = {} for _, num in ipairs (gOrder) do if gRows [num] and gRows [num].entry then keep [#keep + 1] = num end end gOrder = keep renderResults () return end local num = table.remove (gQueue, 1) gProbeCount = gProbeCount + 1 local ok, err = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, probeCmd (num), true, true, true, function (lines) MW_ProbeDone (num, lines) end, false, function () MW_ProbeTimeout (num) end, 12) if not ok then dbg ("probe " .. num .. " failed to start: " .. tostring (err)) MW_ProbeTimeout (num) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- 'market list' capture -- ===================================================================== function MW_ListCaptured (lines) gOrder, gQueue, gProbeCount, gHidBid, gHidPrice = {}, {}, 0, 0, 0
-- Rows are NOT cleared: an item announced on the market channel lives here -- too, and a scan should not kill its links. Drop only what has expired. local cutoff = os.time () - SCAN_TTL for num, r in pairs (gRows) do if (r.seen or 0) < cutoff then gRows [num] = nil end end
local seen, onMarket, sawFooter = 0, {}, false for _, styles in ipairs (lines or {}) do local text = styleText (styles) -- the list ends with "Type: 'market bid <num>' to see stats and ..." if text:find ("to see stats", 1, true) then sawFooter = true end local row = parseListRow (text) if row then seen = seen + 1 onMarket [row.num] = true local kind, entry = classifyRow (row) if kind then if gBid [row.num] then -- Already bid: the proxy stands until the auction ends, so there is -- nothing left to decide. Drop it before it costs an lbid probe. gHidBid = gHidBid + 1 elseif row.bid and row.bid >= entry.max then -- Bidding has already passed what we are willing to pay. The list -- gives us the current bid, so this costs no probe either. gHidPrice = gHidPrice + 1 else row.kind = kind row.entry = entry row.seen = os.time () gRows [row.num] = row gOrder [#gOrder + 1] = row.num end end end end

So absence from the list is only -- meaningful if we actually read the whole list: a capture that got cut off -- would otherwise un-ignore everything it missed and offer it all again. -- Only prune when the closing "Type: 'market bid ...'" footer was seen. if sawFooter then local pruned = 0 for num in pairs (gBid) do if not onMarket [num] then gBid [num] = nil gMktAmt [num] = nil pruned = pruned + 1 end end for num in pairs (gKnownBuyout) do if not onMarket [num] then gKnownBuyout [num] = nil pruned = pruned + 1 end end if pruned > 0 then saveData () dbg ("pruned " .. pruned .. A TextRect hyperlink whose text -- is not a URL is run through loadstring(), so the link text below is plain -- Lua that calls back into this plugin. -- ===================================================================== local gHaveWin = pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local WIN_ID = "MarketWatch_prompt" local POPUP_TTL = 60 -- seconds a prompt stays up if you never answer it -- Pop-up font (v4.2). Consolas ships with Windows; the library default Dina 10 -- is a bitmap font with no larger sizes. Drawn bold, see popupBuild. local POPUP_FONT = "Consolas" local POPUP_FONT_SIZE = 12 local QUEUE_MAX_AGE = 600 -- a prompt that waits this long in the queue is dropped local gWin = nil local gPrompts = {} -- the queue; [1] is the one on screen. -- Build one line of MUSHclient style runs plus its hyperlink list. -- Positions are counted over the VISIBLE text only, which is what TextRect -- indexes against - hence building styles directly instead of colour codes. local function promptLine (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs (segs) do if s.text ~= "" then styles [#styles + 1] = { text = s.text, textcolour = col (s.colour or CLR_MSG) } if s.code then links [#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #s.text - 1, text = s.code, label = s.tip } end pos = pos + #s.text end end return styles, links end
-- Tearing the window down from inside one of its OWN hotspot callbacks (which -- is where a link click runs) leaves MUSHclient with live hotspots pointing at -- an object that no longer exists: the window stays on screen, the close button -- does nothing, and the next right-click dies in RightClickMenuCallback with a -- nil window. So every teardown is pushed onto a timer and happens after the -- callback has returned. The library's own close button defers for the same -- reason (it calls delete(true)). function MW_PopupDestroy () -- a prompt arrived after the close was scheduled: the window is in use again if #gPrompts > 0 then return end local w = gWin gWin = nil if w then pcall (function () w:delete (true) end) end pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) -- also clears a window left behind by a pcall (Repaint) -- half-finished teardown end
function MW_PopupRefresh () popupBuild () end
popupClose = function () gPrompts = {} -- Hide it right now: hiding is safe from inside a hotspot callback, and it -- makes the window go away the instant you click, rather than a tick later. pcall (WindowShow, WIN_ID, false) pcall (Repaint) -- ...then destroy it properly once the callback has returned. 0.2 rather -- than a smaller value because MUSHclient timers will not go below ~0.1s. DoAfterSpecial (0.2, "MW_PopupDestroy ()", sendto.script) end
popupBuild = function () if not gHaveWin then return end if #gPrompts == 0 then gHeadId = nil popupClose () return end

-- Never reuse an object the library no longer knows about. If a teardown -- went wrong the old one is a zombie: its hotspots are live but its entry in -- window_map is gone, and touching it is what produced the nil-window error. if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map [WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end
if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall (ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, -- id 200, 150, -- default left, top 620, 200, -- default width, height (fit_contents resizes it) "MarketWatch", -- title "center", -- title alignment true, -- is_temporary: gives the title-bar close button false, -- resizeable false, -- text_scrollable false, -- text_selectable false, -- text_copyable false, -- url_hyperlinks: no auto URL detection (ours are explicit) true, -- autowrap POPUP_FONT, POPUP_FONT_SIZE, -- title font POPUP_FONT, POPUP_FONT_SIZE, -- text font 60, -- max lines nil, -- padding true, -- defer showing until we have drawn false, nil, "Dismiss") if not ok or not w then gHaveWin = false dbg ("pop-up window unavailable: " .. tostring (w)) return end gWin = w -- Bold everything. A style's own bold flag is ignored unless the world's -- "show bold" option is on, so instead point TextRect's normal font at the -- bold one it already loaded. Widths are measured with the same font, so -- fit_contents still sizes the window to the bold text. if gWin.textrect and gWin.textrect.font_bold then gWin.textrect.font = gWin.textrect.font_bold end -- the [x] button and our No link should behave the same local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function (self) if prior then prior (self) end -- our own teardown clears gWin first, so only a click on the [x] lands here if gWin ~= self then return end gWin = nil -- closing the window dismisses just the prompt that was showing if #gPrompts > 0 then table.remove (gPrompts, 1) end gHeadId = nil if #gPrompts > 0 then DoAfterSpecial (0.3, "MW_PopupRefresh ()", sendto.script) end end end
gWin:clear (false)
for _, p in ipairs ({ head }) do local s, l = promptLine { { text = p.name, colour = CLR_HI } } gWin:add_text (s, false, l)
s, l = promptLine { { text = " " .. p.note, colour = CLR_MSG } } gWin:add_text (s, false, l)
if p.problem then s, l = promptLine { { text = " " .. p.problem, colour = CLR_NAME } } gWin:add_text (s, false, l) end
if p.pending then -- buttons hidden while we wait, so it cannot be sent twice s, l = promptLine { { text = " sending...", colour = CLR_TAG } } gWin:add_text (s, false, l) else -- indent kept out of the links so only the buttons are clickable local segs = { { text = " " } } if p.bids then -- one button per bid tier that still beats the current bid for i, b in ipairs (p.bids) do if i > 1 then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } end segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ BID max" .. b.tier .. " " .. commafy (b.amt) .. " ]", colour = CLR_HI, code = string.format ("MW_PopupAct(%d,%q)", p.id, "bidamt:" .. intstr (b.amt)), tip = "Re-check the item, then bid " .. commafy (b.amt) } end segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } end if p.bid then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ BID " .. ((p.tier and p.tier > 1) and ("max" .. p.tier .. " ") or "") .. commafy (p.bid) .. " ]", colour = CLR_HI, code = string.format ("MW_PopupAct(%d,%q)", p.id, p.bidkind), tip = "Send the bid now" } if p.buy or p.buyover then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } end end if p.buy then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ BUY IT NOW " .. commafy (p.buy) .. " ]", colour = CLR_NAME, code = string.format ("MW_PopupAct(%d,\"buy\")", p.id), tip = "Win it outright now" } elseif p.buyover then -- Deliberately worded and coloured differently from the normal buyout: -- this one spends more than the maximum you set for this item. segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ BUY ANYWAY " .. commafy (p.buyover) .. " - over your max ]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = string.format ("MW_PopupAct(%d,\"buyover\")", p.id), tip = "Buy it outright for MORE than your max for this item" } end -- looking the item over never bids, so it is always on offer segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ ID ]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = string.format ("MW_PopupId(%d)", p.id), tip = "Show the full item in the main window" } s, l = promptLine (segs) gWin:add_text (s, false, l) end end
local waiting = #gPrompts - 1 local tail = { { text = " " }, { text = "[ No ]", colour = CLR_NAME, code = "MW_PopupNo()", tip = waiting > 0 and "Skip this one - the next is shown" or "Close this window and do nothing" }, } if waiting > 0 then tail [#tail + 1] = { text = " " } tail [#tail + 1] = { text = "[ Skip all ]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = "MW_PopupSkipAll()", tip = "Dismiss every waiting prompt" } tail [#tail + 1] = { text = " (" .. waiting .. " more waiting)", colour = CLR_DIM } end local s, l = promptLine (tail) gWin:add_text (s, false, l)
pcall (function () gWin:fit_contents (1000, 600) end) gWin:draw () gWin:show () -- We are usually inside a trigger or timer here, and MUSHclient holds the -- screen until that returns - without this the window does not appear until -- something else happens to repaint. pcall (Repaint) end
-- Add a prompt. Returns true when the pop-up has taken responsibility for -- this item, so the caller can skip its normal echo and not say it twice. -- -- p = { id, family = "mkt"|"auc", num, name, note, -- bid = <amount>, bidkind = "bid"|"auc", -- optional -- buy = <buyout> } -- optional local gPromptSeq = 0
local function popupAdd (p) if not gCfg.popup or not gHaveWin then return false end for _, q in ipairs (gPrompts) do -- market and auction numbers are different spaces, so match on both if q.num == p.num and q.family == p.family then return true end end gPromptSeq = gPromptSeq + 1 p.id = gPromptSeq p.when = os.time () p.queued = p.when if p.front then table.insert (gPrompts, 1, p) -- a replacement for the prompt just resolved else gPrompts [#gPrompts + 1] = p end popupBuild () -- Never leave it sitting there if nobody is at the keyboard. MW_PopupArmExpire () -- Only claim it if a window really exists now. If the build failed the -- item must go back to the normal echo rather than vanish from both. if not gWin then for i, q in ipairs (gPrompts) do if q.id == p.id then table.remove (gPrompts, i) break end end return false end return true end
-- Called by a link click. The id makes this unambiguous - matching on the -- item number alone could hit the wrong entry, since auction 97 and market 97 -- are different items. function MW_PopupAct (id, action) id = tonumber (id) if not id then return end local target for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.id == id then target = p break end end if not target then return end if target.pending then return end -- already waiting on this one
-- The prompt is NOT removed here. Whether the bid actually goes through is -- only known once the MUD answers, and if it fails for want of gold the -- window has to stay up with the buttons still on it. target.pending = true target.problem = nil target.when = os.time () -- restart its expiry clock
local num = target.num local bidamt = type (action) == "string" and action:match ("^bidamt:(%d+)$") if bidamt then target.sentamt = tonumber (bidamt) MW_Click_BidAmt (nil, nil, { tostring (num), bidamt }) elseif action == "auc" then MW_Click_AucBid (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) elseif action == "buy" then MW_Click_Buy (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) elseif action == "buyover" then -- you clicked a button that spells out the price, so the max is waived MW_Click_Buy (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }, true) else target.sentamt = target.bid MW_Click_Bid (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) end -- redraw once we are out of the click callback, same reasoning as the -- deferred teardown above DoAfterSpecial (0.2, "MW_PopupRefresh ()", sendto.script) DoAfterSpecial (6, "MW_PopupSettle (" .. id .. ")", sendto.script) end
-- A few seconds after acting, decide what happened. The ledger is the -- evidence: a bid that went through is recorded there, and one that failed -- has been un-recorded again by MW_NotEnoughGold. function MW_PopupSettle (id) id = tonumber (id) local target, index for i, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.id == id then target, index = p, i break end end if not target or not target.pending then return end
local placed if target.family == "auc" then placed = gAucBid [target.num] else placed = gBid [target.num] -- a re-bid on an item we already had a bid on: gBid was set before, so the -- recorded amount is what shows this click really went through if placed and target.sentamt and (gMktAmt [target.num] or 0) < target.sentamt then placed = nil end end
if placed then target.pending = false table.remove (gPrompts, index) -- done with it popupBuild () return end
-- Not recorded yet. A market bid re-reads the item with a silent lbid -- first, which can outlast this timer, so give it a couple more goes before -- calling it a failure. target.settleTries = (target.settleTries or 0) + 1 if target.settleTries < 3 then DoAfterSpecial (6, "MW_PopupSettle (" .. id .. ")", sendto.script) return end
target.pending = false if not target.problem then target.problem = "that did not go through - still yours to take" end popupBuild () end
-- Called when the MUD refuses a bid. Keeps the prompt on screen, says why. local function popupFail (family, num, message) for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.num == num and p.family == family then p.pending = false p.problem = message p.when = os.time () -- give it a fresh minute to act on popupBuild () return true end end return false end
-- Show the item. Deliberately does NOT touch the prompt: reading the id is -- not a decision, so the window stays exactly as it was. function MW_PopupId (id) id = tonumber (id) for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.id == id then if p.family == "auc" then Send ((CMD_AUCID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (p.num)))) else Send ((CMD_PROBE:gsub ("%$num", intstr (p.num)))) end return end end end
-- "No": dismiss the prompt on screen only; the next one in the queue comes up. function MW_PopupNo () if #gPrompts > 0 then table.remove (gPrompts, 1) end gHeadId = nil if #gPrompts == 0 then popupClose () return end -- We are inside the old prompt's own click callback, so the redraw waits a -- moment (same reasoning as the deferred teardown above). Hide it now so -- the click is seen to work. pcall (WindowShow, WIN_ID, false) pcall (Repaint) DoAfterSpecial (0.2, "MW_PopupRefresh ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_PopupSkipAll () popupClose () end
-- One expiry check chain at a time. The front prompt lives POPUP_TTL seconds -- from reaching the front (or from its last click); anything still waiting is -- dropped after QUEUE_MAX_AGE. function MW_PopupArmExpire () if gExpireArmed then return end gExpireArmed = true DoAfterSpecial (10, "MW_PopupExpire ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_PopupExpire () gExpireArmed = false local now, kept = os.time (), {} for i, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do local live if i == 1 then live = now - (p.when or 0) < POPUP_TTL else live = now - (p.queued or p.when or 0) < QUEUE_MAX_AGE end if live then kept [#kept + 1] = p end end if #kept ~= #gPrompts then gPrompts = kept popupBuild () -- closes the window if that emptied it end if #gPrompts > 0 then MW_PopupArmExpire () end end
-- Drop the prompt for an item that is no longer for sale. Called from the -- "sold" lines on both channels - who won does not matter, the chance is gone. local function popupDrop (family, num, name) local kept, dropped = {}, false local target = name and norm (name) or nil for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do local hit = (p.family == family) and ((num and p.num == num) or (target and target ~= "" and norm (p.name) == target)) if hit then dropped = true else kept [#kept + 1] = p end end if not dropped then return end gPrompts = kept popupBuild () end
-- "Auction: A Trivia Point Token SOLD to Madrox for 12,000,665 gold." function MW_AuctionSold (name, line, wildcards) line = tostring (line) -- the market's own sold line carries a "Num nnnnn" - that one is not ours if line:find ("Num%s+%d+") then return end local item = line:match ("^%s*[Aa]uction:%s*(.-)%s+SOLD to") or line:match ("^%s*(.-)%s+SOLD to") if not item or item == "" then return end popupDrop ("auc", nil, item) end
-- "Market: (Vibrant) {>-Long dark green leaf-<} (Level 198, Num 64808) sold to Pigmao for 5,250,000 Gold." function MW_MarketSold (name, line, wildcards) local num = tonumber (tostring (line):match ("%(Level%s+%d+,%s*Num%s+(%d+)%)%s+sold to")) if not num then return end popupDrop ("mkt", num, nil) -- it has left the market, so the ledgers should forget it now rather than -- waiting for the next scan to notice if gBid [num] or gKnownBuyout [num] then gBid [num] = nil gKnownBuyout [num] = nil saveData () end gRows [num] = nil end
-- ===================================================================== -- The LIVE auction channel -- -- Sample line this was written against: -- Auction: Betrayal is auctioning a Trivia Point Token (Level 1, Num 97). -- Current bid is 100. -- -- Unlike the market list, the auction line carries the FULL item name, so a -- match here is exact and needs no probing. The bid also uses a different -- command and a different number space - see CMD_AUC and gAucBid. -- ===================================================================== local gAuc = {} -- auction num -> { name, level, bid, entry, when } local gAucLast = { line = "", when = 0 }
-- Pick the best watch entry for a full, untruncated item name. -- chan is "auc" (live auction) or "mkt" (market channel); entries whose mode -- excludes that channel are skipped. local function matchWatch (fullname, chan) local hay, best = norm (fullname), nil for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do if modeAllows (w, chan) and piecesMatch (hay, w.pieces) then if not best or w.max > best.max then best = w end end end return best end
function MW_AuctionDebug (name, line, wildcards) if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw auc] " .. tostring (line)) end end
-- We already bid on this auction and a repeat of the channel line shows the -- price has moved. If someone has outbid us and a higher tier (max2 / max3) -- still beats the price, offer that tier. Each tier is offered once per -- auction. Nothing is sent until the button / link is clicked. local function aucRaise (num, item, w, cur, now) local myamt = gAucAmt [num] if not myamt or not cur then return end if cur <= myamt then return end -- not outbid local amt, tier = nextTier (w, cur) if not amt then return end -- past every tier you set local last = gAucOffer [num] if last and now - last.when < AUC_BID_TTL and amt <= last.amt then return end
gAucOffer [num] = { amt = amt, when = now } -- the record may be gone (plugin reloaded since we bid), so rebuild it local a = gAuc [num] if not a then a = {} gAuc [num] = a end a.name = item a.entry = w a.bid = cur a.when = now a.second = true -- marks this as a raise on top of a standing bid a.second_amt = amt a.tier = tier

if popupAdd { family = "auc", num = num, name = item, bid = amt, bidkind = "auc", tier = tier, note = "Auction " .. num .. " OUTBID - now " .. commafy (cur) .. " you bid " .. commafy (myamt) .. " max" .. tier .. " " .. commafy (amt) } then return end
echoHi ("outbid: ", item, string.format (" (Num %d, now %s, you bid %s)", num, commafy (cur), commafy (myamt))) local preview = CMD_AUC:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucbid " .. num, "[ BID max" .. tier .. " " .. commafy (amt) .. " ]", "Send: " .. preview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucid " .. num, "[ ID ]", "Show the item: " .. CMD_AUCID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)), CLR_TAG, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " tier " .. tier .. " of your watch entry " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw)) end
-- "Auction: Aberrant has placed a bid for 12,000,000 gold on <item> (Level 1, Num 77)." -- Someone bidding on an auction we have a bid on means we were outbid: offer the -- next tier up (max2, then max3) if one still beats the new price. function MW_AuctionBidLine (name, line, wildcards) if not gCfg.auc then return end local bidder = tostring (wildcards [1] or "") local cur = tonumber ((tostring (wildcards [2] or ""):gsub (",", ""))) local item = tostring (wildcards [3] or "") local num = tonumber (wildcards [4]) if not cur or not num or item == "" then return end
if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("[marketw auc] bid line: %s bid %s on %q (Num %d) ours=%s", bidder, commafy (cur), item, num, tostring (gAucAmt [num]))) end
-- our own bid echoing back if gmcp_name and bidder:lower () == gmcp_name:lower () then return end -- only auctions we actually bid on if not gAucBid [num] or not gAucAmt [num] then return end
local w = matchWatch (item, "auc") if not w then return end aucRaise (num, item, w, cur, os.time ()) end
function MW_AuctionLine (name, line, wildcards) if not gCfg.auc then return end line = tostring (line)
-- the channel repeats itself; ignore an identical line seen seconds ago local now = os.time () if line == gAucLast.line and now - gAucLast.when < 5 then return end gAucLast.line, gAucLast.when = line, now
-- "<seller> is auctioning <ITEM> (Level <n>, Num <n>)" local item, level, num = line:match ("is auctioning%s+(.-)%s*%(Level%s+(%d+),%s*Num%s+(%d+)%)") num = tonumber (num) level = tonumber (level) if not item or item == "" or not num then if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw auc] could not parse: " .. line) end return end
-- "Current bid is 100." - absent on some lines, so it stays nil local cur = line:match ("[Cc]urrent bid is%s+([%d,]+)") cur = cur and tonumber ((cur:gsub (",", ""))) or nil
local w = matchWatch (item, "auc") if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("[marketw auc] item=%q level=%s num=%d bid=%s match=%s", item, tostring (level), num, tostring (cur), w and w.raw or "none")) end if not w then return end -- already bid: the bid stands, so say nothing - unless we have been outbid -- and a higher tier is available, in which case that tier is offered if gAucBid [num] then aucRaise (num, item, w, cur, now) return end -- bidding is already past every tier you set: nothing to act on, stay quiet local offer, tier = nextTier (w, cur) if not offer then return end local tierTag = tier > 1 and ("max" .. tier .. " ") or ""

(cur and (" current bid " .. commafy (cur)) or "") .. " your " .. (tier > 1 and ("max" .. tier) or "max") .. " " .. commafy (offer) } then return end
echoHi ("auction match: ", item, string.format (" (Num %d, L%s%s)", num, tostring (level or "?"), cur and (", bid " .. commafy (cur)) or ""))
local preview = CMD_AUC:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (offer)) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucbid " .. num, "[ BID " .. tierTag .. commafy (offer) .. " ]", "Send: " .. preview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucid " .. num, "[ ID ]", "Show the item: " .. CMD_AUCID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)), CLR_TAG, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " matches " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw)) end
-- ===================================================================== -- MARKET BID LINE (v5.0) -- -- Market: Bid of 1,001 gold on <item> (Level 201, Num 66719) -- -- is printed whenever someone bids on a market item. It names the item, its -- number and the new bid, which is everything needed - there is no market list -- read and no probe to decide anything. It is handled the way the auction -- channel is: -- * you have not bid, and the bid is below one of your maxes: a pop-up offers -- the lowest max that beats it (max1; or max2 when it is already past max1, -- and so on); -- * you have bid, and a later line shows a higher bid (you were outbid) that a -- higher max still beats: the pop-up opens again with that max. -- One button at a time; nothing is ever sent without a click. -- Put a refused market bid back the way it was: forget it entirely when it was -- the first bid on the item, or restore the earlier bid when it was a raise. local function undoMarketBid (b) if b.prevbid then gBid [b.num], gMktAmt [b.num] = b.prevbid, b.prevamt else gBid [b.num], gMktAmt [b.num] = nil, nil end end
-- "Current bid on <item> is now 15,000,000. Min bid is 15,050,000." -- The bid we just sent was refused because it did not beat the current bid by -- enough. Nothing was bid, so undo the record of it, then offer the lowest tier -- (max2, max3) that clears the minimum. Nothing is sent until you click. function MW_BidTooLow (name, line, wildcards) local item = trim (tostring (wildcards [1] or "")) local cur = tonumber ((tostring (wildcards [2] or ""):gsub (",", ""))) local minbid = tonumber ((tostring (wildcards [3] or ""):gsub (",", ""))) local b = gLastBid if not b or not cur or not minbid then return end if os.time () - b.when > BID_FAIL_WINDOW then return end
local a = gAuc [b.num] if b.auction and a and a.name and norm (a.name) ~= norm (item) then return -- about some other item: not our bid end gLastBid = nil
if not b.auction then -- marketplace bid refused: undo it, then offer the lowest max that clears -- the minimum (the same as for an auction) undoMarketBid (b) saveData () local row = gRows [b.num] local mw = row and row.entry local mamt, mtier if mw then for i, v in ipairs (tierList (mw)) do if v >= minbid then mamt, mtier = v, i break end end end if mamt then mktOffer (b.num, row.visible or item, row.level, mw, cur, mamt, mtier, true, "BID TOO LOW - min " .. commafy (minbid)) return end popupFail ("mkt", b.num, "bid too low - current " .. commafy (cur) .. ", min bid " .. commafy (minbid)) echoHi ("bid too low on item ", tostring (b.num), string.format (" - current %s, min bid %s - above all your maxes.", commafy (cur), commafy (minbid))) return end
local num = b.num -- undo the record of the refused bid if b.second then gAucAmt [num] = b.prev -- the earlier bid still stands else gAucBid [num] = nil gAucAmt [num] = nil end saveData ()
local w = (a and a.entry) or matchWatch (item, "auc") if not w then return end
-- lowest tier that clears the minimum local amt, tier for i, v in ipairs (tierList (w)) do if v >= minbid then amt, tier = v, i break end end
-- the prompt for the refused bid is spent either way popupDrop ("auc", num, nil)
if not amt then echoHi ("bid too low on ", item, string.format (": current %s, min bid %s - above all your max bids (%s), so nothing to offer.", commafy (cur), commafy (minbid), tierText (w))) return end
a = a or {} gAuc [num] = a a.name = item a.entry = w a.bid = cur a.when = os.time () a.tier = tier if gAucBid [num] then a.second, a.second_amt = true, amt -- raising a bid that still stands else a.second, a.offer = false, amt -- nothing standing: a first bid end gAucOffer [num] = { amt = amt, when = os.time () }

echoHi ("bid too low: ", item, string.format (" (Num %d, now %s, min bid %s)", num, commafy (cur), commafy (minbid))) local preview = CMD_AUC:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucbid " .. num, "[ BID max" .. tier .. " " .. commafy (amt) .. " ]", "Send: " .. preview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucid " .. num, "[ ID ]", "Show the item: " .. CMD_AUCID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)), CLR_TAG, "black", 0, 1) Note ("") end

function MW_MarketLine (name, line, wildcards) if not gCfg.mkt then return end line = tostring (line)

function MW_AnnounceRender (num) num = tonumber (num) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry or not row.announced then return end if row.rendered then return end row.rendered = true gPendingAnnounce = nil
local w = row.entry local st = row.stats
local reasons = {} if row.ctype ~= "Gold" then reasons [#reasons + 1] = "not a gold auction" end
local canBuy = st and st.buyout and w.max >= st.buyout and row.ctype == "Gold"
-- Every listing you could act on goes to the window - with BUY IT NOW too -- when the buyout is within reach. Only listings with nothing to click -- (not a gold auction) fall through to the echo below. if #reasons == 0 then local note = "Num " .. num if st and st.buyout then note = note .. " buyout " .. commafy (st.buyout) end note = note .. " your max " .. commafy (w.max) -- a buyout within your max is the normal button; one above it is -- offered too, but as a separate, clearly-labelled action local buyAmt, buyOver if st and st.buyout then if canBuy then buyAmt = st.buyout else buyOver = st.buyout end end if popupAdd { family = "mkt", num = num, name = row.visible, bid = w.max, bidkind = "bid", buy = buyAmt, buyover = buyOver, note = note } then return end end

-- ===================================================================== -- Topping up from the bank when a bid falls short -- -- Only ever fires in the one room you nominate, and only within a few -- seconds of a bid we actually sent. It withdraws, it never re-bids: the -- retry is a link you click, so nothing is ever spent without a click. -- -- The failure line is the same for both systems (confirmed 2026-08-21): -- lbid 64940 1001 -> You are only carrying 0 gold pieces. -- bid 27 1000 -> You are only carrying 0 gold pieces. -- It states the gold on hand, so the shortfall needs no guessing. -- The bank command is "withdraw <amount>" (confirmed 2026-08-21). -- ===================================================================== local CMD_WITHDRAW = "withdraw $amt"
function MW_NotEnoughGold (name, line, wildcards) local b = gLastBid if not b then return end if os.time () - b.when > BID_FAIL_WINDOW then gLastBid = nil return end gLastBid = nil
-- "You are only carrying 0 gold pieces." - authoritative, and fresher than -- the GMCP figure, so it wins when present. local carrying = tostring (line):match ("only carrying%s+([%d,]+)%s+gold") carrying = carrying and tonumber ((carrying:gsub (",", "")))
-- The bid did NOT happen, so undo the record of it - otherwise the item -- would stay hidden from every future scan for something we never bought. if b.auction and b.second then -- a failed SECOND-CHANCE bid must not erase the record of the first bid, -- which stands; just re-arm the offer so it can be retried local a = gAuc [b.num] if a then a.second = true a.second_amt = b.amt a.when = os.time () end gAucAmt [b.num] = b.prev elseif b.auction then gAucBid [b.num] = nil gAucAmt [b.num] = nil else undoMarketBid (b) end saveData ()
-- If this came from the pop-up, keep the window open and say why, with the -- buttons live again so it can be retried once there is gold in hand. popupFail (b.auction and "auc" or "mkt", b.num, "not enough gold on hand - nothing was sent" .. (carrying and (" (carrying " .. commafy (carrying) .. ")") or ""))
local retryAlias = b.auction and ("mwaucbid " .. b.num) or ("mwbid " .. b.num)
echoHi ("bid on item ", tostring (b.num), " failed - not enough gold on hand.") ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", b.second and " your earlier bid still stands; the raised bid can be retried." or " it is no longer marked as bid, so it will be offered again.")
if not gCfg.withdraw then ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink (retryAlias, "[ RETRY BID ]", "Try the bid again", CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " ('marketw withdraw on' to top up from the bank automatically)") return end
if gCfg.withdrawroom == 0 then warn ("withdraw is on but no room is set - stand in your bank and use 'marketw withdrawroom here'.") return end local here = currentRoom () if here ~= gCfg.withdrawroom then warn ("not withdrawing: you are in room " .. tostring (here or "unknown") .. ", withdrawals are only done in room " .. gCfg.withdrawroom .. ".") if not here then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " (room unknown - is aard_GMCP_handler loaded?)") end return end
-- Take out the FULL bid amount, not just the shortfall. Covering only the -- gap would leave you at zero gold the moment the bid goes through. local have = carrying or gGold local need = b.amt if have and have >= need then warn ("you already carry " .. commafy (have) .. " - nothing withdrawn.") return end if gBank and gBank < need then warn ("not withdrawing: the bank holds " .. commafy (gBank) .. ", short of the full " .. commafy (need) .. ".") return end
local cmd = CMD_WITHDRAW:gsub ("%$amt", intstr (need)) echoHi ("withdrawing ", commafy (need), have and (" (the full bid amount - you were carrying " .. commafy (have) .. ")") or " (the full bid amount)") Send (cmd) -- Hold the retry link back for a second. The bank prints your account -- details right after a withdrawal, and that would scroll the link away. DoAfterSpecial (1, "MW_ShowRetry (" .. intstr (b.num) .. ", " .. tostring (b.auction) .. ")", sendto.script) end

-- marketw set <number> <max1> [max2 [max3]] [auc|mark|both] -- e.g. marketw set 3 1000 20000 300000 auc -- The amounts given replace ALL of the item's tiers; the mode is only changed -- when a mode word is given. A lone mode word changes just the mode. function MW_Cmd_Set (name, line, wildcards) local target, rest = trim (wildcards [1]), trim (wildcards [2]) local w = findEntry (target) if not w then warn ("no watch entry matches " .. string.format ("%q", target) .. ". Try: marketw list") return end
local tiers, mode = {}, nil for tok in rest:gmatch ("[^%s/]+") do local m = parseMode (tok) if m then mode = m else local v = parseAmount (tok) if not v then warn ("could not read " .. tok .. " as an amount or mode.") ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " usage: marketw set <n> <max1> [max2 [max3]] [auc|mark|both]") return end tiers [#tiers + 1] = v end end if #tiers > 3 then warn ("at most three amounts: max1 max2 max3.") return end if #tiers == 0 and not mode then warn ("usage: marketw set <n> <max1> [max2 [max3]] [auc|mark|both]") return end for i = 2, #tiers do if tiers [i] <= tiers [i - 1] then warn ("each max must be higher than the one before it (max1 < max2 < max3).") return end end
if #tiers > 0 then w.max, w.max2, w.max3 = tiers [1], tiers [2], tiers [3] end if mode then w.mode = mode end saveData () echoHi ("item " .. tostring (tonumber (target) or "") .. " " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ": ", tierText (w), " gold (" .. MODE_LABEL [w.mode or "both"] .. ")") end
-- marketw max2|max3 <number|text> <amount|off> function MW_Cmd_Max (name, line, wildcards) local tier = tonumber (wildcards [1]) local target = trim (wildcards [2]) local word = trim (wildcards [3]):lower () local w = findEntry (target) if not w then warn ("no watch entry matches " .. string.format ("%q", target) .. ". Try: marketw list") return end
if word == "off" or word == "none" or word == "clear" then if tier == 2 then w.max2, w.max3 = nil, nil -- max3 means nothing without max2 else w.max3 = nil end else local v = parseAmount (word) if not v then warn ("usage: marketw max" .. tier .. " <number|text> <amount|off>") return end if tier == 3 and not w.max2 then warn ("set max2 first - max3 has to sit above it.") return end local floor = (tier == 2) and w.max or w.max2 if v <= floor then warn ("max" .. tier .. " must be higher than " .. commafy (floor) .. ".") return end if tier == 2 and w.max3 and v >= w.max3 then warn ("max2 must stay below max3 (" .. commafy (w.max3) .. ").") return end if tier == 2 then w.max2 = v else w.max3 = v end end saveData () echoHi ("watching " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. " up to ", tierText (w), " gold.") end

Each probe is -- four commands (two echo tags, the lbid, a blank line), so the defaults are -- deliberately conservative. function MW_Cmd_Throttle (name, line, wildcards) local arg = trim (wildcards [1]) if arg == "" then echoHi ("at most ", tostring (gCfg.probe_max), " item(s) checked per scan, " .. gCfg.probe_delay .. -- ===================================================================== -- Clicking a bid link -- ===================================================================== local function sendBid (row, amt, why) local cmd = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (row.num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) gLastBid = { num = row.num, amt = amt, auction = false, when = os.time (), prevbid = gBid [row.num], prevamt = gMktAmt [row.num] } gBid [row.num] = os.time () gMktAmt [row.num] = amt saveData () echoHi ("sending: ", cmd, why and (" (" .. why .. ")") or "") Send (cmd) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " item " .. row.num .. " will not be offered again.") end
-- second stage: fresh stats are in, decide whether to send local function bidVerified (num, forced, wantAmt) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry then warn ("item " .. num .. " is no longer in the last scan.") return end local w = row.entry local st = row.stats local amt = wantAmt or w.max if wantAmt and wantAmt > topTier (w) then warn ("refused: " .. commafy (wantAmt) .. " is over your highest max " .. commafy (topTier (w)) .. ".") return end
if row.ctype ~= "Gold" then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is a " .. tostring (row.ctype) .. " auction, not gold.") return end
if not st or not st.name then if not forced then local preview = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) warn ("could not re-read item " .. num .. " to confirm it. Nothing sent.") ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwbidforce " .. num, "[ SEND ANYWAY: " .. preview .. " ]", "Send the bid without confirmation", CLR_WARN, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") return end else if not piecesMatch (norm (st.name), w.pieces) then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is " .. string.format ("%q", st.name) .. ", which does not match " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ".") return end -- the stats box states the currency on the bid line ("25,000,000 gold") if st.currency and st.currency:lower () ~= "gold" then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is priced in " .. st.currency .. ", not gold.") return end local cur = st.bid or row.bid or 0 if cur >= amt then warn ("refused: current bid " .. commafy (cur) .. " already meets your max " .. commafy (amt) .. ".") return end if st.minbid and st.minbid > amt then warn ("refused: minimum next bid " .. commafy (st.minbid) .. " is over your max " .. commafy (amt) .. ".") return end if st.bidder and gmcp_name and st.bidder:lower () == gmcp_name:lower () then warn ("refused: you are already the high bidder on item " .. num .. ".") return end end
sendBid (row, amt, st and st.name or nil) end
local function clickBid (num, forced, amt) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry then warn ("item " .. tostring (num) .. " is not in the current scan. Run 'marketw' again.") return end if os.time () - (row.seen or 0) > SCAN_TTL then warn ("that listing is over " .. math.floor (SCAN_TTL / 60) .. " minutes old. Run 'marketw' again first.") return end if gBid [num] then -- outbid items may be bid on again, but only for more than we bid before if not (amt and gMktAmt [num] and amt > gMktAmt [num]) then warn ("you already have a proxy bid on item " .. num .. " - nothing sent.") return end end if forced then bidVerified (num, true, amt) return end
echo ("re-checking item " .. num .. " before bidding...") local ok = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, probeCmd (num), true, true, true, function (lines) if gRows [num] then gRows [num].stats = parseStats (num, textsOf (lines)) end bidVerified (num, false, amt) end, false, function () warn ("re-check timed out - nothing sent.") end, 12) if not ok then warn ("re-check failed to start - nothing sent.") end end

".") return end if force and row.entry.max < row.stats.buyout then warn ("buying over your max: " .. commafy (row.stats.buyout) .. " vs " .. commafy (row.entry.max) .. " - you asked for this one.") end -- send exactly the buyout price, not your max local cmd = CMD_BUY:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)) :gsub ("%$amt", intstr (row.stats.buyout)) gBid [num] = os.time () gLastBid = { num = num, amt = row.stats.buyout, auction = false, when = os.time () } saveData () echoHi ("sending: ", cmd, " (buyout on " .. (row.stats.name or "item " .. num) .. ")") Send (cmd) end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP: remember our own character name (used to skip our own high bids) -- ===================================================================== gmcp_name = nil function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end -- Route on the message name. Matching '"name"' in every packet would pick -- up room.info's ROOM name and store it as the character name. local msg = data:match ("^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not msg then return end msg = msg:lower ()
if msg == "char.base" then local n = data:match ('"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if n then gmcp_name = n end
elseif msg == "room.info" then local n = data:match ('"num"%s*:%s*(%-?%d+)') if n then gRoom = tonumber (n) end
elseif msg == "char.worth" then local g = data:match ('"gold"%s*:%s*(%d+)') local k = data:match ('"bank"%s*:%s*(%d+)') if g then gGold = tonumber (g) end if k then gBank = tonumber (k) end end end
